How much can you really build on this plot? 🏗️

New free tool: Plot Envelope.
Enter the plot, setbacks, ground coverage, FAR and the height limit. It applies them all together, tells you which rule governs and how much FAR goes unused, with a live 3D envelope, plan and floor schedule.

✅ Setbacks, coverage, FAR and height in one place

caption:
Is carpet area really 70% of super built-up? 🏢

New free tool: Carpet Area.
Type the rooms and their sizes, add walls, balcony and shafts, and set the loading. It gives the RERA carpet, built-up and super built-up areas in m² and sq ft, and what you really pay per carpet sq ft.

✅ RERA Act 2016 §2(k) carpet area

caption:
How many truckloads will this slope need? 🚚

New free tool: Cut & Fill.
Enter the four corner levels of a sloping plot and place the building pad. It works out cut, fill, the balanced pad level and how many truckloads go out or come in, with contours, a live section and a table of pad level options.
